outcome: Sexual function (evaluated by PISQ and FSFI)
cohort: The study included 101 healthy women and 74 patients diagnosed with OAB syndrome.
finding: Women with OAB syndrome had significantly lower scores on sexual function indices (FSFI and PISQ) and higher scores on urogenital distress (UDI-6) and OAB symptom questionnaires (ICIQ-OAB) compared to healthy controls.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively from January 2020 to January 2024.
